module_summary: Write-only AXI4 slave to Wishbone master bridge: skid-buffered AW/W channels unwind bursts into pipelined Wishbone writes, with ack counters and BID/error FIFOs generating B responses.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: AXI write-address valid feeding the address skid buffer

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWADDR
anchors.why: AXI burst start address captured through awskid

anchors.name: S_AXI_WVALID
anchors.why: AXI write-data valid feeding the write skid buffer

anchors.name: S_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: AXI write data payload forwarded to o_wb_data

anchors.name: S_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: Write response valid when both BID and error FIFOs are non-empty

anchors.name: S_AXI_BREADY
anchors.why: Response ready; pops BID/err FIFOs and decrements fill counters

anchors.name: S_AXI_BID
anchors.why: Response ID read out of bid_fifo

anchors.name: S_AXI_BRESP
anchors.why: Response code; bit 1 from err_fifo marks slave error

anchors.name: o_wb_cyc
anchors.why: Wishbone cycle line, raised on burst accept, dropped after last ack or error

anchors.name: o_wb_stb
anchors.why: Wishbone strobe issuing one write per accepted W beat

anchors.name: o_wb_addr
anchors.why: Wishbone word address taken from burst address register axi_waddr

anchors.name: o_wb_data
anchors.why: Wishbone write data registered from skid_wdata, optionally byte-swapped

anchors.name: o_wb_sel
anchors.why: Wishbone byte selects registered from write strobes

anchors.name: i_wb_stall
anchors.why: Wishbone stall backpressure gating strobe, data and burst acceptance

anchors.name: i_wb_ack
anchors.why: Wishbone ack decrementing outstanding acks and ack length tracking

anchors.name: i_wb_err
anchors.why: Wishbone error response forcing err_state and aborting the cycle

anchors.name: accept_write_burst
anchors.why: Accepts new AW burst: loads burst registers, starts cycle, pushes ack FIFO

anchors.name: skid_wready
anchors.why: Ready to write skid buffer; advances address and beat counting

anchors.name: skid_awready
anchors.why: Idle flag: low while a burst is being unwound, gates W acceptance

anchors.name: wlen
anchors.why: Remaining beats counter of active burst

anchors.name: axi_wid
anchors.why: ID of active burst, compared to block ID changes and pushed to bid_fifo

anchors.name: axi_waddr
anchors.why: Current burst address, loaded on accept and advanced by axi_addr each beat

anchors.name: acks_expected
anchors.why: Outstanding Wishbone acks counter, blocks ID switches while nonzero

anchors.name: writes_expected
anchors.why: Counts completed W bursts awaiting B response

anchors.name: last_ack
anchors.why: Marks final expected ack so o_wb_cyc can drop

anchors.name: err_state
anchors.why: Error recovery mode after bus error, aborts cycles until FIFOs drain

anchors.name: read_ack_fifo
anchors.why: Pops next burst length from wb_ack_fifo when ack tracking needs it

anchors.name: acklen
anchors.why: Remaining acks in current burst for response generation

anchors.name: ack_last
anchors.why: Last ack of burst flag, triggers ack FIFO read and err_fifo write

anchors.name: ack_err
anchors.why: Accumulated error over a burst, written into err_fifo

anchors.name: total_fifo_fill
anchors.why: Bursts in flight count; MSB is full flag blocking new bursts

anchors.name: err_fifo_write
anchors.why: Pushes per-burst error status into err_fifo at burst end

groups.name: AXI input skid buffers
groups.description: Skid buffers registering AW and W channels before burst unwinding

groups.name: Burst controller
groups.description: Accepts bursts and tracks active burst ID, length and idle state

groups.name: Burst address generator
groups.description: Holds burst address and advances it per beat via axi_addr

groups.name: Wishbone master
groups.description: Issues pipelined Wishbone writes from W beats

groups.name: Ack tracking
groups.description: Counts outstanding acks and burst lengths via wb_ack_fifo to find burst completion

groups.name: Error handling
groups.description: Error recovery state and per-burst error recording into err_fifo

groups.name: Write response channel
groups.description: BID FIFO and error FIFO producing AXI B responses
